component.name: EasyEffects Auto Preset
component.summary: Automated EasyEffects preset switcher for YouTube and Voice Meetings

description.p: EasyEffects Auto Preset is an intelligent, high-performance preset manager and switcher for EasyEffects on Linux. Powered by PipeWire and PulseAudio audio stream monitoring, it seamlessly switches your output effects depending on active audio activity:

ul.li: Automatically engages bass-boosted and dynamic presets (e.g. Crystal more Bass) when YouTube or media is playing.

Automatically engages voice-optimized presets (e.g. Compressed-Max or Meeting-Voice-Clear) when any voice meeting or call is active (Google Meet, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Slack, Discord, or active microphone input).
Restores default settings cleanly with configurable debounce delay when audio ends.
Offers both a native, ultra-lightweight Rust daemon and a feature-complete PyQt6 Settings & Tray manager.

description.p: Initial release featuring native Rust daemon, PyQt6 Tray manager, Flatpak packaging, and custom voice meeting presets.
